[CRITICAL] CLOSE_REQUIRED
subject: plan-0001
reason: OPERATOR_CLOSE
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
What happened: An operator asked to close this plan (OPERATOR_CLOSE).
Position: A position may be open; this message does not say whether it has a stop.
System already did: The plan moved to CLOSE_REQUIRED, new entries are blocked (SAFE_MODE CLOSE_REQUIRED) and a reduce-only MARKET emergency close was attempted; if that close fails, EMERGENCY_CLOSE_FAILED or EMERGENCY_CLOSE_NOT_SENT follows as its own alert. An open stop is kept until the position is flat; the stop is never cancelled here. The close quantity is read from the exchange, never guessed.
You must: Check on the exchange that the position is flat and read the journal for OPERATOR_CLOSE; if it is still open, close it yourself.
